news.headline: Canaccord Genuity and Cantor Fitzgerald Initiate Nektar Therapeutics at Buy With $153 Price Targets
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity and Cantor Fitzgerald both initiated coverage of NKTR on July 22, 2026 with Buy ratings and identical $153 price targets, implying substantial upside from the prior close and reinforcing the broader Street consensus that firmed up after the ZENITH-AD Phase 3 launch. The dual initiations add to a mostly bullish analyst roster on the stock.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, each enrolling about 510 biologic- and JAK inhibitor-naive atopic dermatitis patients (roughly 1,530 total across all three planned trials), with a third trial (ZENITH AD-3) for biologic/JAK-experienced patients due to start in September 2026. The release also confirmed initial Phase 3 topline data are expected mid-2028, a planned BLA submission in 2029, and a registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata trial start pushed to early 2027.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Stock Looks Above Fair Value Despite Its 7x Run
news.summary: A July 20, 2026 valuation review found NKTR trading at a price-to-sales multiple well above both the pharmaceuticals-industry average and Simply Wall St's estimated fair multiple, arguing that after the stock's roughly 7x three-year run a great deal of optimism about rezpegaldesleukin's future revenue is already priced in. The piece cautions there is little room for disappointment given the multi-year wait for pivotal Phase 3 data.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NASDAQ:NKTR) Stock Price Up 5.2% Amid Broad Analyst Buy Consensus
news.summary: NKTR shares gained about 5% on July 9, 2026, extending the summer rally, with the stock carrying a consensus 'Strong Buy'-leaning rating from analysts (roughly seven to ten Buy ratings versus one Hold) and price targets spanning from Wedbush's $80 to Piper Sandler's $192, averaging near $138-153 depending on the source.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Clocks Best Day in Over Two Months Ahead of Upcoming Eczema Clinical Data
news.summary: NKTR shares jumped roughly 10.65% on July 2, 2026 after Canaccord flagged Nektar as a likely sentiment beneficiary of AbbVie's pending $10.9 billion acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics in immunology/dermatology, with investors also positioning ahead of the July 2026 start of the Phase 3 ZENITH-AD program.

news.headline: How Nektar Therapeutics' Broad FTSE Russell Index Inclusion Will Impact NKTR Investors
news.summary: Nektar was added to the Russell 2000, 2500 and 3000 indices (and related growth/value/small-cap variants) in the FTSE Russell semi-annual reconstitution completed June 27, 2026, a move expected to draw passive, benchmark-tracking fund flows into the stock.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Third-party earnings calendars (TipRanks, Zacks, Nasdaq, StockEarnings) list Nektar's next quarterly results date as around August 6, 2026, with commentary expected on ZENITH-AD enrollment progress and cash runway (guided into Q3 2028 after roughly $1.07 billion raised since mid-2025). Not yet formally confirmed via a Nektar press release as of July 25, 2026.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: Following the July 21, 2026 start of ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2 (each enrolling ~510 biologic- and JAK inhibitor-naive atopic dermatitis patients), Nektar plans to begin ZENITH AD-3, a third registrational trial of similar size enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor treatment experience, in September 2026.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata program start
catalysts.detail: Nektar's July 21, 2026 release confirmed plans to initiate a single registrational Phase 3 trial of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata in early 2027, following an End-of-Phase 2 meeting with the FDA and scientific advice from the EMA, building on positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept and 52-week extension data and the drug's FDA Fast Track designation.

catalysts.label: New-indication proof-of-concept study start
catalysts.detail: Nektar intends to initiate a proof-of-concept study of rezpegaldesleukin in at least one additional autoimmune/inflammatory indication beyond AD and alopecia areata, with initial data expected in 2027.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 Type 1 diabetes data (TrialNet collaboration)
catalysts.detail: Initial data from the TrialNet-sponsored Phase 2 study of rezpegaldesleukin in approximately 70 patients with new-onset Stage 3 Type 1 diabetes mellitus is expected to be reported in 2027.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH-AD Phase 3 data readout
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2 biologic-naive atopic dermatitis studies are expected, marking the first pivotal efficacy readout for rezpegaldesleukin.

catalysts.label: Planned BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Nektar has guided to a Biologics License Application submission for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in 2029, contingent on positive Phase 3 results.

pulse: As of July 25, 2026, Nektar's story centers on the July 21 launch of its pivotal Phase 3 ZENITH-AD program, which dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2 with a third trial (AD-3) due to start in September 2026 and topline data not expected until mid-2028; the same release pushed the planned Phase 3 alopecia areata trial start to early 2027. Shares have rallied hard since late June, helped by the program launch, a June 27 FTSE Russell index-inclusion flow boost, spillover optimism from AbbVie's pending $10.9 billion acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics, and fresh Buy initiations from Canaccord Genuity and Cantor Fitzgerald on July 22 (both at $153 targets) - though a July 20 Simply Wall St valuation piece cautioned that NKTR's elevated price-to-sales multiple already prices in a great deal of optimism years ahead of any pivotal data. The next scheduled catalyst is Q2 2026 earnings, unofficially expected around August 6, 2026.
